description: This file defines a generic class BufferWriterBox<TBufferWriter> that implements IBufferWriter<byte> by wrapping another buffer writer instance, providing access to the underlying buffer writer and forwarding buffer operations.

classes.name: BufferWriterBox<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A wrapper class that boxes another buffer writer, enabling it to be used as an IBufferWriter<byte> with a boxed interface.

methods.name: BufferWriterBox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer writer being boxed.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Provides a reference to the underlying buffer writer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Forwards the call to the underlying buffer writer to advance the buffer.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Gets a Memory<byte> from the underlying buffer writer.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Gets a Span<byte> from the underlying buffer writer.
